claims: The 2026 World Baseball Classic (WBC) final is scheduled for Tuesday, March 17, 2026, at 8 p.m. ET.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic (WBC) final will take place at loanDepot Park in Miami, Florida.
Team USA will face the winner of the Venezuela vs. Italy semifinal matchup in the 2026 World Baseball Classic (WBC) final.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic (WBC) final will be broadcast on FOX.
